articles.title: Paradigm shifts vs bubbles: AI chips and bitcoin show powerful trends can still produce severe corrections
articles.snippet: Structural change can create lasting opportunities, but explosive rallies in semiconductors, metals and bitcoin show how quickly strong narratives can become speculative excess.

articles.title: Bonzo Lend loses $9M in oracle exploit on Hedera
articles.snippet: An attacker inflated the value of SAUCE collateral and borrowed $9 million from Bonzo Lend through a flaw in Supra’s onchain oracle verifier.

articles.title: AI Agents Could Be Turned Into Botnets Through Hallucinations, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: Researchers warn AI agents could be tricked into downloading malicious code by exploiting the same hallucinations that cause chatbots to make mistakes.
